Care for Creation Milltown Care for Creation Group will meet on Thursday afternoon next, November 26th, at 2:30pm in the Parish Pastoral Centre, all are welcome. WONDER WITH THE WORD Scripture Sharing – Lectio Style Society appears increasingly secularized and unbelieving. Our challenge is to ensure that Christ remains the centre of our lives. HOW? Our group will meet EACH TUESDAY in Advent, starting on this coming Tuesday, November 24th at 3pm in Milltown Parish Pastoral Centre, to turn our hearts towards the “Light of the World”, to “Stay awake ” on our “Journey” to Bethlehem. It is a gentle, shared reflection time using the Sunday scripture readings and prayer. We invite and welcome YOU to join us as we “Wonder with the Word .” Milltown Active Retirement Association Saturday 28th November in Milltown Golf Club at 7pm Payment is now due to confirm your booking. Please see the poster on our Noticeboards for further details. MILLTOWN CHOIR CAROL SERVICE Sunday, December 13th at 3:30pm Milltown Parish Church Refreshments afterwards in the Parish Pastoral Centre Admission Free Altar List of the Dead & Remembrance Tree During the month of November, we invite parishioners to write their Annual List of the Dead. Envelopes are available at the entrance of the Church. Mass on the First Friday of each month during the year is offered for those whose names are on our Altar List of the Dead. You are also invited to write the names of your departed loved ones on the labels provided and place them on the Remembrance Tree . We at Missio Ireland extend our thanks to the parishioners of Milltown parish, for their generosity on Mission Sunday. An amount of €1,060 has been received, for which we are very grateful. The support of each parishioner who donated to this worthy cause is very much appreciated.
